table.bytes_today_which: Q4-vehicle traffic and mixed-1p5-ne4 catalog (165306651 with header). mixed-1p5-v1 is 320889115 Q8.
table.candidate: keep HGRAVU01 q4 (incumbent Q4 vehicle / ne4)
table.reconstruction_cost_class: uniform_dequant_gemv; measured 1.25 ms @ 131.9 GB/s on this tensor
table.quality: vs BF16: 373/384 greedy match (97.14%), 11 flips. vs mixed-1p5 Q8: 371/384 (96.61%), 13 flips. weight cosine 0.99364, logit cosine 0.99622.
table.verdict: KEEP as the Q4-vehicle / ne4 incumbent. Do not advertise as token-identical to mixed-1p5 or to BF16. The 12-token reverse-string generate is too small a gate: this 384-hidden screen already flips 3.4% vs Q8.

table.quality: vs BF16: 382/384 (99.48%), 2 flips, both near-tie (margins 0.0027 and 0.013). weight cosine 0.999980, logit cosine 0.999988. Draft coverage vs BF16 hits 100% at k=2.
table.alters_note: Campaign grades mixed-1p5 against the artifact oracle, not BF16. Q8 is the mixed-1p5 authority.
table.verdict: KEEP for mixed-1p5. Highest-fidelity packed head we have. Still not bit-identical to BF16.

table.candidate: drop mixed-1p5 lm_head Q8 → Q4 full eval (already on disk as mixed-1p5-ne4)

table.quality: 13/384 greedy flips vs Q8 authority (3.39%). Mean top1-top2 margin on the Q8 side is 1.72; some flips have margin 0.15, not just ties.
table.verdict: CAPABILITY CHANGE, not an optimization. Reject as a silent overlay onto mixed-1p5. ne4 is a different artifact and must be generate-gated on its own.
REJECT as full eval. Capability change.
REJECT as full eval. Capability change.

table.verdict: REJECT. Capability change. Also the wrong codec family for this organ under the Q80 reconstruction lesson.

table.candidate: replace with SVD r256 f16 (or hgravs01-style two-matvec)
table.reconstruction_cost_class: two_matvec, cheap; CPU 9 ms-class for r256 vs 15 ms materialized gemv (DIRTY, one hidden)
table.quality: 35/384 (9.11%) greedy match. r256 captures only 29.92% of ||W||_F^2. r160 (hgravs analog) captures 25.11%. lm_head is HIGH RANK.
table.verdict: REJECT. Structural negative: low-rank is the wrong tool for this matrix. Do not port down_proj's HGRAVS01 here.

table.candidate: two-pass: Q3 uniform DRAFT + exact rescore of k=8 authority rows
table.reconstruction_cost_class: uniform_dequant_gemv on 126 MB then 8 row gathers (~17 KB). ~0.96 ms sequential.
table.quality: On 384 L47-proxy hiddens, Q3 top-8 contains the BF16 argmax 384/384 and the Q8 argmax 384/384. Q3 top-4 is 99.5%. Q3 used as full eval (no rescore) flips 37/384 — that path is a capability change. Exact rescore of those 8 rows is NOT.
table.alters_note: False only if the rescore is exact against the same authority matrix and k>=8 holds on generate, not just this screen. Sampling / top-p is a different gate: a draft that covers greedy argmax can still miss nucleus mass and change sampled tokens. GREEDY identity is the gate that passed here. Sampling is UNMEASURED and must be treated as a capability change until measured.
table.verdict: ONLY traffic mechanism that cleared the greedy-identity gate. Storage tax is real (must keep exact rows). Best vs mixed-1p5 Q8 traffic (321→126 MB). Marginal vs a Q4-only vehicle (165→126 MB) and costs a second tensor. Do not ship without a generate-id identity gate. Recommend k=32 in any implementation (35 KB) as a screen margin; k=8 was exact-100 on this set.

table.candidate: two-pass: Q4 uniform DRAFT + exact rescore of k=4 authority rows
table.quality: Q4 top-4 contains BF16 argmax 384/384 and Q8 argmax 384/384. Q4 top-2 is 99.22% vs BF16 / 99.22% vs Q8. Q4 full eval (no rescore) flips 11 vs BF16 and 13 vs Q8.
table.alters_note: Same conditions as the Q3 two-pass row. Sampling UNMEASURED.
table.verdict: Identity-preserving vs Q8/BF16 on this screen, but traffic equals just running Q4. Only useful if authority stays Q8 (or BF16) and you refuse to change tokens. Storage = Q4 + authority.

table.candidate: two-pass: SVD r256 / prefix-d512 cheap projection + exact rescore
table.projected_bytes_traffic_if_it_worked: r256 f16 factors 78.8 MB + k rows; prefix-d512 Q4 41.3 MB + k rows
table.reconstruction_cost_class: two_matvec or prefix sequential read, cheap
table.quality: NO k<=1024 reached 100% coverage. SVD r256 k=1024 hit 87.8%. prefix d512 k=1024 hit 98.2%. SVD r256 k=32 hit 47.9%.
table.alters_note: Using these drafts to pick a candidate set and then even exact-rescoring that set WILL change the greedy token whenever the true argmax is outside the set. That happened on this screen at every k we tried.
table.verdict: REJECT. This is a capability change, not an optimization. The 'cheap projection' idea is the right SHAPE and the wrong BASIS for this matrix. Uniform-quant drafts work; low-rank and row-prefix drafts do not.

table.candidate: keep current uniform row gather (Q4 or Q8 matching the pack)

table.quality: Q8 row cosine mean 0.999981 min 0.999878 (520 rows). Q4 mean 0.993933 min 0.978141. Q3 mean 0.9687 min 0.9273. Q2 mean 0.7759 min 0.6929. binary min 0.3118.
table.alters_emitted_tokens: INDIRECT if the row changes. A gather error shifts the residual of every subsequent layer. Not a logit-local error. Token identity after 48 layers UNMEASURED for any embed requant.

Sub-Q4 and binary have an ugly min-row-cosine tail; bit-budget ledger already records GLM R0 sub-bit embed as catastrophic. Do not spend reconstruction cost on 1 KB.

central_risk.statement: lm_head is the most accuracy-sensitive tensor: a logit error becomes the emitted token with no downstream layer to absorb it.
central_risk.what_we_measured: On 384 real late-layer (L47 router-input, RMSNorm'd) hiddens, even Q8 already flips 2 near-tie greeds vs BF16. Q4 flips 11 vs BF16 and 13 vs Q8. Q3/Q2/binary/SVD flip tens to hundreds. The risk is real and shows up as soon as you leave Q8, not only at sub-bit.
central_risk.what_two_pass_changes: A cheap draft that misses the true argmax is the same risk. SVD and prefix drafts miss it more than half the time at k=32. A Q3/Q4 uniform draft plus exact rescore did not miss it on this screen.
